scope: Input-assignment audit, not validation of cross-specimen anatomical registration or visual behavior.

source.axes: x forward, y left, z dorsal; eye equator from lens anatomy; head-rig alignment assumed

summary.registration: Centre-aligned hex axes across specimens; orientation and peripheral correspondence unvalidated
